dedupe_keys.name: asphalt pavement crack segmentation dataset for mobile road distress assessment

description: Politecnico di Milano researchers publish 2,209 pavement photographs with manually labelled crack masks. The free CC BY 4.0 Zenodo release provides JPEG images and PNG masks, divided into 1,480 training, 498 validation and 231 test pairs. Photographs from handheld and vehicle-mounted acquisition include shadows, surface variation and distracting objects. These labels can calibrate pavement-condition observation models that supply infrastructure-maintenance simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this annotated collection. Coverage is the deposited image sample, with precise sites and acquisition dates not established in the summary. Label uncertainty and possible similarities between acquisition scenes affect generalisation; segmentation accuracy alone does not establish structural condition or remaining service life. No images were downloaded, splits audited or segmentation model trained.
